newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Hilton Jan '97s active.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Hilton Jan '97s active.

text.p: Two January 1997 call options on shares of Hilton Hotels Corp were busy on Tuesday, but traders said the activity was not likely linked to the stock's movement.
Hilton shares ended down 1-3/8 at 104-3/4 on consolidated volume of 390,000 shares.
The Hilton January 1997 85 call traded 1,410 contracts and ended down 1/2 at 22-3/8. Its open interest through Monday was 424.
The January 1997 90 call, which had open interest of two, traded 1,510 contracts. It finished down 5/8 at 18-1/8.
In addition to those two calls, the September 100 put traded 1,215 contracts and the October 100 put traded 600.
Traders said that activity could have been related to the move in the stock.
Salomon Brothers was said to be involved in both the active puts and calls.

"It was institutional activity not linked to the stock," decline on Tuesday, one trader said of the action in the January 1997 options. He said it was likely a series of spreads and could have been an interest rate play. --G.Crawford, (312) 408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
